name: Release readiness
description: Run a release readiness pass from a reviewed integration point with reproducible artifacts, explicit gates, and rollback evidence.

outcomes.description: Scope, version, changelog, tests, observability, owner boundaries, and artifact checks have outcomes.
The release artifact and previous release are identifiable in a redacted terminal receipt.

prerequisites.description: The source is at a reviewed integration point with no unresolved scope or test failure.
prerequisites.check: Inspect status, diff summary, and relevant test result before release work.

prerequisites.description: The intended audience, release notes, health signal, and rollback owner are known.
prerequisites.check: Write the communication and rescue facts without private or secret values.

lanes.objective: Walk through readiness, version, changelog, observability, owner boundaries, and rollback gates.
Build and inspect a reproducible release artifact from the reviewed integration point.
Verify release checks, artifact traceability, health evidence, and rollback identification.

qualityGates.description: Every readiness gate has a pass, fail, or explicit not-applicable result.
The artifact is reproducible and traceable to the reviewed integration point.
Health evidence and the prior release route are recorded before any irreversible promotion.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Enter a password, one-time code, passkey, or challenge response for a release system.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop and hand the entry to the owner; prepare artifacts and evidence without typing secrets.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Authentication material is a human-only boundary.

ownerConfirmationBoundaries.action: Promote live traffic, change billing or account security, perform destructive work, or execute live financial behavior.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.boundary: Stop before the action and obtain one explicit owner confirmation for that individual action.
ownerConfirmationBoundaries.reason: Readiness evidence does not itself authorize live impact.

rollbackRescue.rollbackPlan: Keep the prior release and return to it through the documented route when a release gate or health signal fails.
rescueSteps: Capture redacted checklist, artifact, and health summaries.
Preserve the release artifact for review without promoting it.
Record the failed gate and mark the release abandoned when needed.
stopConditions: A readiness gate is missing or contradictory.
The artifact cannot be traced to reviewed source.
A protected owner boundary is reached.

redactionRules: Omit credentials, tokens, private paths, and private communication content.
Record safe release identifiers and status summaries only.
